title: I shouted above the sudden noise
excerpt: I shouted above the sudden noise. She looked away from me downhill. The people were coming out into the fjord mist as silence enveloped the mountain.
author: Astrid Lindholm
content:
I shouted above the sudden noise. She looked away from me downhill. The people were coming out into the fjord mist as silence enveloped the mountain ridge. The temperature had plunged twelve degrees in thirty minutes as clouds descended into the valley.

The Silence of Glacial Valleys

In the Norwegian interior, acoustics behave with supernatural clarity. A whisper can travel half a kilometer across water, yet a shout can be muffled by thick damp pine boughs.

We spent three days camping at the edge of the lake, capturing the changing gradients of alpine dawn and dusk.
